backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing user profiles, submission histories, and fusion records with access control and storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping fusion‑related features to frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of all major frontend files for build planning reference.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global theme defining OKLCH color tokens and dark‑mode variants.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the React app and setting branding metadata.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component managing app views with theme and React Query providers.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Layout wrapper providing top navigation, main content, and footer.
frontend/src/components/HiddenVariations: UI panel listing hidden fusion outputs with restore and regenerate actions.
frontend/src/components/HistoryDetail.ts: Detailed history view showing input photos and generated outputs for each entry.
React component for selecting, validating, previewing, and removing JPG/PNG images with metadata extraction.
frontend/src/components/TopNav.tsx: Top navigation bar that switches between landing, generate, and history views.
frontend/src/components/VariationGrid.ts: Displays a grid of variation images with preview, download, and hide actions, plus modal viewer support.
frontend/src/components/VariationViewerD: Modal dialog that shows a large preview of a variation image with a download button.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity, auto‑refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, handling login, logout, identity loading, and status management.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching history and submitting or clearing submissions through the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining base styles and a neon-themed color system along with utility classes.
frontend/src/lib/fusion/contributionGuar: Computes feature-based similarity between two input images and a fusion output to reject near-duplicates. Includes downsampling, luminance, edge, and histogram extraction with a similarity threshold.
frontend/src/lib/fusion/edgeAwareBlend.t: Provides edge-aware blending tools including mask feathering, gradient maps, and edge-influenced blend mask generation. Used to smooth seams and preserve structural edges in fused images.
frontend/src/lib/fusion/patchFusion.ts: Generates patch-based masks for mixing two images, including grid, multi-scale, and gradient-aware variants. Supports seeded randomness for reproducible region selection.
frontend/src/lib/historyStorage.ts: Manages localStorage-based history of fusion outputs with add, read, and clear functions. Stores photo pairs, variations, and timestamps.
frontend/src/lib/imageMeta.ts: Loads an image file to extract width, height, and byte size metadata. Uses a temporary object URL to read image dimensions.
frontend/src/lib/onDeviceVariations.ts: Selects fusion recipes and generates on-device image fusion variations with retries and contribution checks. Combines patch masks, edge-aware blending, and optional color adjustments.
frontend/src/lib/semanticVariationTransf: Empty placeholder file for semantic-based variation transforms.
frontend/src/lib/variationPresets.ts: Empty placeholder file for variation preset definitions.
frontend/src/lib/variationState.ts: Defines the VariationItem interface for storing generated variation metadata.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React, React Query, and Internet Identity before rendering the root component.
frontend/src/pages/History.tsx: UI for viewing, selecting, and clearing stored fusion history entries, with detail view support and confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/LandingIntro.tsx: Hero landing page showing brand logo, gradient title, and introductory manifesto letter with a Get Started button.
frontend/src/pages/UploadAndGenerate.tsx: Two‑photo upload page that generates fusion variations, manages history, and supports hiding, restoring, and regenerating outputs.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL parameters, storing them in sessionStorage, and managing hash-based params.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, fonts, animations, and enabling plugins like typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing app purpose, architecture notes, known issues, and existing feature definitions.
